text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East has 182 capsules of lansoprazole 30 mg (19 days on hand), Corvale General has 255 capsules (27.7 days), and Corvale Lakeside has 35 capsules (15.3 days). FDA's records show lansoprazole is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): The label for NDC 50090518000 names A-S Medication Solutions as labeler and plant (FEI 1450743) with operations RELABEL and REPACK. FDA inspection 1331612 at that plant ended 2026-08-12 with classification VAI, known to FDA on 2026-10-14. A Warning Letter was issued to A-S Medication Solutions LLC (FEI 1450743) on 2017-06-05.

Our position: Current inventory covers 15 to 28 days across sites. No FDA shortage listing exists. The preferred supply route is Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list and uses Hetero Labs Limited Unit III (last inspection VAI 2023-07-21).

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places purchase order with Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. — approved by Pharmacy Director.
2. Buyer monitors daily usage at all three sites and updates days-on-hand — approved by Pharmacy Manager.
3. Buyer qualifies Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, Ajanta Pharma USA Inc., Ascend Laboratories, LLC, and BluePoint Laboratories as backup sources — approved by Pharmacy Director.

Not recommended: No allocation or rationing at this time. No clinical protocol changes; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
